description: Vertical numbered list of a wireframe document's pages: the Pages tab of the TmWireframeEditor left panel (PageNavigation=Panel), also usable standalone. Click switches the active page; each row has a "..." menu (Rename, Duplicate, Move up, Move down, Delete) and an Add page button sits below the list. Every operation has a non-drag alternative (WCAG 2.5.7): the row menu, F2 to rename, Alt+Up / Alt+Down to reorder; HTML5 drag-and-drop is a pointer-only extra. The panel MUTATES Document (page operations are not undoable, like the page tabs) and reports through ActivePageChanged / DocumentChanged. The Delete key never deletes a page; the last page cannot be deleted. ReadOnly removes add, menu, drag, rename and the shortcuts; selecting a page still works.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Document whose pages are listed. Mutated in place: pages are added, renamed, reordered, duplicated and deleted, and ActivePageId is set when the user switches page.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the (mutated) document after every change: switch, add, rename, duplicate, delete, reorder.

parameters.name: ActivePageChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the id of the page that became active after a switch, add, duplicate or delete (not for plain reorder or rename), before DocumentChanged.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: When true the list is view-only: no add button, no row menu, no drag-and-drop and no rename or reorder shortcuts. Selecting a page still works.

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Whether the panel renders its own "Pages" heading. Defaults to true for standalone use; a host whose tab or section already says "Pages" (the left panel of the editor) passes false so the word is not repeated.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the panel root.

keyboardShortcuts.action: Move the focused page up / down
